New bunch of patches. I believe this should be the last of the major bugs that would prevent a smooth experience
- Fixed an issue in where the mod would not prevent you from continuing forward if you don't have the next stage

- Change how things are printed to the console so log files are not in a single line making them far more readable

Pre-release.description:
# Tetris Effect: Archipelago v0.1.0
The first release is out! This is still full of bugs and errors but it is playable. This version includes:
- Stage completion unlocks
- Integration of most Effect levels
- Rank checks, on individual stages and by area
- Zone as an item
- Traps and death link
- Location checks by performance and tricks (like doing t spin triples and zones)
- In game client and text log

For more information check out the [Tetris Effect doc](https://github.com/ZatchyBeeps/Archipelago-TEC/blob/main/worlds/tetriseffect/docs/en_Tetris%20Effect.md) and the [setup guide](https://github.com/ZatchyBeeps/Archipelago-TEC/blob/main/worlds/tetriseffect/docs/setup_en.md) to install it.
Please inform me of any bugs you find! Happy randomizing!
Pre-release.title: Tetris Effect: Archipelago v0.1.0

V0.2.0.description:
Bigger update! Has quite the fixes and new implementations which makes everything a lot more stable:
## New Stuff
- Swap traps have been added. When triggered your current active and hold minos swap without input.
- The text log now supports colors like a usual archipelago text client
- An experimental prevention to the data package changed issue
- Your area score now gets saved between stages of the same area for Ranksanity. You will see the current total score after placing your first mino on a stage of the same area (the score will get reset if you go to a different area or replay one of the stages)
- "Bonus points" and "Zone charge bonus" now do something in-game. Bonus points grants 1000 points. Zone charge bonus increases your zone charge by a quarter
- New option to set how zone locations are obtained

## Changes
- Decreased trap chance from 25% to 12.5%
- Decreased some trap durations:
- - Broken mino traps now lasts 10 seconds instead of 15
- - Hold traps now last 15 seconds instead of 30
- - Ghost piece traps now last 20 seconds instead of 30
- - Queue traps now last 15 seconds instead of 30
- Removed combo back-to-back trick locations
- Changed most trick location requirements to lower values
- - T-spins from 10 to 4
- - Back-to-backs from 10 to 3
- - Tetris clears from 15 to 6
- - Combos from 8 to 4
- B ranks now require the zone mechanic
- Bump area rank's amount of stages unlocked to achieve
- Change option names with clearer names and descriptions
- Changes to the docs + made a step-by-step ue4ss install guide if their guide is too confusing
- The connection menu now displays the mod version
- Speed trap now adapts to difficulty as it was just too mean:
- - On easy, sets the speed to 15
- - On normal, sets the speed to 20
- - On expert, sets the speed to M13 (the original behaviour lol)

## Fixes
- Metamorphosis and the zone are, for *real*, now properly locked and without errors
- Fixed issue in where you randomly stopped getting rank checks until reconnection
- Ghost piece traps can now be triggered
- Playlist modes now properly send their mode clear location
- Fix a bug that would give double the amount of stage completions in the game
- The Story mode stage selection now prevents selection of locked levels better without breaking the cursor
- The connection menu no longer hides when going around menus, like the options, on the main menu
- Ranksanity is now considered on rule creation, which would prevent generation if false
- Made sure that some player options are actually used on generation

Find the setup guide [here!](https://github.com/ZatchyBeeps/Archipelago-TEC/blob/main/worlds/tetriseffect/docs/setup_en.md)
Please continue telling me about any errors you find please! Happy randomizing!
V0.2.0.title: Tetris Effect: Archipelago v0.2.0

V0.2.1.description:
More fixes and stability with a bunch of improvements!
To setup, go to the [setup guide.](https://github.com/ZatchyBeeps/Archipelago-TEC/blob/main/worlds/tetriseffect/docs/setup_en.md)

## Client:
- Fix to Quick Play not sending checks (made available already on prev. version)
- Traps now display an on screen message above the center of the board when triggered
- You can now see the amount of levels cleared and levels required to access Metamorphosis on stage select
- Fix ap instance crashing when receiving deathlink with empty message
- Your last connection's details now get saved. No more inputting the details every time you open the game
- Connection helper can now be hidden for privacy concerns
- Remove an error message that would show when you connect and receive the zone on worlds in where you didn't started with it
- Accumulated area score is now displayed in the Total Score when in game, allowing you to keep track of stage and area scores at the same time
- Fix to behavior when game changes scenes, allowing Classic Score Attack to be played
- Fixed bug that would duplicate stage completions when automatically reconnecting after connection is lost

## AP world
- Fixed excluding Target mode giving a generation error
- Separate and add ranksanity option for Effect modes
- Fixed a critical generation error when there's more than one player playing this apworld (funny this hasn't been the case as no one seem to have found this error)
- Add accessibility option to allow trick locations to be obtained in Effect modes
- Excluded Effect mode unlocks are now considered filler
- Rewrite to docs to make clearer what this randomizer does


**This version is backwards compatible with older versions.** You can upgrade your client mod and continue playing on previously generated worlds safely. This will not be the case with the next release tho.
Please continue telling me any errors you find!
V0.2.1.title: Tetris Effect: Archipelago v0.2.1
